build.notes: Library-only build (make -C lib) followed by a compile-and-link of a small stdin driver (test.c, a third-party build input kept in environment/third_party/concollmic with its licence) with the coverage flags into obj-gcov/program. GCC records the generated parser and scanner sources under obj-gcov/lib; build.stage_sources lists the copies that put them there, which the builder makes after the build and the runner repeats. environment/README.md names the driver file and its pinned SHA-256.
